approval.rationale: Face-on, rough, matte grey granite with black mica and pale feldspar grains at the 2 m tile scale and nothing that repeats as a feature; the speckle-only layout fixed the moss cushions (43101), the whole-boulder perspective (43102) and the camouflage patches (43103).
limitations: Very even: little large-scale colour or weathering variation, so close up it reads slightly like coarse concrete; boulder shape and baked AO carry the variation.
No lichen, cracks or moss; mountains and cliffs in W3 need a weathered rock layer.
Graded darker and greyer in the cook (gain 0.6, saturation 0.5); on the smooth W0 boulders it still reads as a cool, even grey under the overcast sky.
